proc_p: Bathroom furniture usually takes four to six weeks to make after you approve the design.
steps: We measure the room and check the pipework, basin and toilet positions before we design anything.
You see the vanity units and storage in 3D, with a quote that lists every cabinet and worktop.
Every cabinet is built to your room in our workshop from materials suited to steam and splashes.
We fit the furniture around your plumbing, covered by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Send us a photo of the bathroom on WhatsApp or book a visit. We’ll measure up and send a 3D design with an itemised quote.
